title: Staff Nurse
description:
Nova IVF Fertility (Rhea Healthcare Pvt Ltd) is looking for Staff Nurse for Tirupati Location: Qualification: B Sc/MSc Nursing Experience : 2 to 4 years in relavent field(females only) Vacancy: 2 Location: Tirupati Job Description: Welcoming and greeting the patient at Nova Introducing self as the patient nurse Understanding the patients purpose of visiting the floor Give admission to the patient as per her requirement To escort patient to her room/ward After the patient reaches her room or ward, the nurse will have to orient her about: What to expect during her stay in the hospital today Orientation on the same floor facilities and hospital services What to do in case of any query Assist Consultants, Gynecologists, Physicians and Medical Officers during their rounds in the hospital On admission measure and note temperature, pulse, BP and other vitals of the patient and inform the Medical officer/Assistant Gynecologist Assist the technician for ECG Give injections, start pint etc.. as per order of the consultant Carefully shift the patient to the OT as per planned time. Shift the patient back to her room/ward and again follow the order of consultant Explain patient relative all relevant information before and after the procedure/surgery. If the anxiety level of the patient is high, the nurse can inform the medical officer and if the need be can also inform Gynecologist. Taking rounds of the patient at regular interval and fill up vitals of the patients as per nursing sheet. Explain the patients relative to visit the drug store and pay for the drugs used in the OT Perform the following activities before discharge: Give medicines, operation CD, reports and discharge card if applicable to the patient Remove VIGO/Urine bag etc. as per nursing protocol Check all the vitals like, Nausea, Vomiting, fever, BP etc. of the patient Check the payment status of the patient Wave a happy and get well soon goodbye to the patient and assure them that they will be fine soon and incase of any query they can always contact Dr. Mira Dave Maintain drug stock everyday and check the expiry of the drug every 3 months Give trigger injections to OPU patients 2 days before the OPU procedure To prepare dressing tray and send it for autoclave. The autoclave tray can be used only for two days otherwise it has to be autoclaved again. Assist Gyneacologists/Medical Officers in dressing (Medical) of the patients. To be always kind and well-mannered to the patients and colleagues and remain well groomed as per policy of the hospital. To maintain Medical Records as per law To follow all instructions for Medical Waste Management To remain groomed as per hospital policy and maintain cordial relations with patients and coleagues While joinning the duty for the day take the message from the previous duty nurse and while leaving for the day give message if any to the next nurse joining the duty. Take indoor rounds of the already admitted patients Maintain the order book for the injections/medicines given to the patients. To participate in all training and developments sessions whenever planned by management To follow all the instructions, duties and responsibilities as given by the management time and again.

Key Skills: OT,Nursing
